meta.name: Vitriol-Tallow Crucible Brazier
meta.description: The Infinite Scriptorium of the Lithic Choir - Blind monastic archivists of Quill Hollow discovered that bedrock is frozen acoustic music, using zero-damage stalls and bell harmonics to shatter equal-depth contours. Socketed into a tool, this vitriol and tallow brazier refines pewter gravel upon breaking blocks, resonating bell harmonics that convert overkill damage into splash damage to shatter adjacent strata.
meta.author: jules
